tukey_cutoffs.note_verbatim: Note: If the calculated lower or upper outer fence exceeds the minimum or maximum range of the measure, then the minimum or maximum measure score is shown in the table. This means that no outliers were identified at that end of the measure score range. For D04 (decline) group, the upper cut off is technically the lowest value below zero since zero is included in the D04 (improved) group.

pre_guardrail_thresholds.note_verbatim: Notes: These are not the final thresholds for the 2026 Star Ratings. See the Measure Details section for final thresholds after guardrails have been applied.
pre_guardrail_thresholds.semantics: Mean resampling estimated thresholds AFTER Tukey outlier deletion, BEFORE guardrails. For higher-is-better rows the four cut points are the 'lo' of star levels 2-5; for lower-is-better rows they are the 'hi' of star levels 2-5.

final_vs_pre_guardrail_check.method: string-exact comparison of K-3/K-4 values against the published final Cut Points CSVs (with '>=100' == '=100' on 0-100 scales)
final_vs_pre_guardrail_check.reading: EQUAL means guardrail did not change that measure's cut points (either exempt or non-binding); a dict means guardrails moved at least one cut point.
